best_existing.covers: Runs several accounts of one MCP server (2 Gmails, several Slack/Notion workspaces) as one toolset in Claude Code and Codex

shortcomings.what: Built-in connectors still allow one account per connector in Claude and Claude Code on the web; the issue is open and active
Codex apps/connectors still lack multiple named accounts; open
Composio's own guide says Claude sometimes uses the wrong inbox, accounts per toolkit default to 5, and Team/Enterprise users may need an Owner to add the custom connector
google_workspace_mcp multi-account stdio mode discards successful token refreshes, forcing spurious re-auth (open)
google_workspace_mcp: caller-provided account email is trusted over the credential's real email (open), so a wrong-account choice by the agent is not caught
User report of an agent working in the wrong Gmail account for 2+ hours with no identity check before inbox operations

note: Third-party multi-account MCP servers and Composio let one session reach several accounts of the same service, but built-in connectors in Claude and Codex remain single-account, and the workarounds report wrong-account actions and token/re-auth bugs.

PermissionRequest hook 'allow' is ignored for ExitPlanMode since v2.1.199, so hooks cannot fully replace prompts
Remote Control mobile app shows prompts despite --dangerously-skip-permissions (open)
Skills/subagents do not inherit user-level allow rules (open)
Dippy config rules do not match commands with global flags such as git -C
Dippy: Cursor bugs limit its ability to operate
Codex still requires per-project trust approval (open)
Gemini CLI workspace policy files do not take effect (open)
Gemini CLI v0.63.0 breaks yolo mode (open)

note: Hook-based policy engines like Dippy work around unreliable rule matching in Claude Code, but they have their own matching gaps, some prompts cannot be overridden by hooks, and Codex trust and Gemini policy problems are not covered.
